name: @@ disambiguates lines that repeat
ambiguous lines without @@ are refused
indentation differences still match at the loosest level
an empty buffer takes pure additions
additions after an @@ line go right after it
Codex envelope lines are tolerated
patch:
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: main.py
-x = 1
+x = 2
*** End Patch

name: lines that are not in the code are refused
a patch with no change is refused
the @@ line repeated as the first context line
an append at the end before an earlier change still lands at the end
an append to code ending in a newline adds no blank line
a later change cannot reach back into an earlier one
